summary: A 75-year-old woman slipped and fell while crossing a creek about 1.5 miles up the Capitol Ditch Trail (an approach trail to Capitol Lake from the Capitol Creek Trailhead); a family member called 911 around 12:10 p.m. reporting shortness of breath and back/rib pain; 17 Mountain Rescue Aspen volunteers, CareFlight of the Rockies, and two Pitkin County deputies responded; a CareFlight helicopter from Rifle landed at the scene (~9,500 ft) around 1:33 p.m. and flew her to St. Mary's Medical Center in Grand Junction around 2:11 p.m.
location: Capitol Ditch Trail, ~1.5 mi from Capitol Creek Trailhead
notes: Date deduced: article says the fall happened on a Friday and the page was updated 2022-09-03; 2022-09-02 was a Friday. Source is an Aspen Times press-release retelling scraped by dailycoloradonews (page opened 2026-09-14).
